financial_package.note: Pay Level S-14 under Maharashtra Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2019 (Maharashtra 7th Pay Commission).
financial_package.pay_source_label: Maharashtra Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2019, Government Resolution No. RPS-2019/CR-1/Services-9
financial_package.estimate_note: Basic pay ₹38,600 in Level S-14 (₹38,600 - ₹1,22,800). Gross range calculated with 58% DA (₹22,388) and HRA varying from 9% (Z-class cities) to 27% (X-class cities like Mumbai/Pune/Nagpur), plus local travel allowances for tax inspections, minus standard 10% NPS and state insurance deductions.
official_perks: Government quarters or House Rent Allowance (HRA up to 27% in metro postings)
Official inspection and enforcement travel allowances
Comprehensive medical coverage under Maharashtra State Government Employees Health Scheme
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and defined state gazetted holidays
Reimbursement of official telephone and conveyance expenses
Defined contributory pension scheme benefits under NPS

competition_benchmarks.note: State Tax Inspector posts are recruited through the MPSC Maharashtra Non-Gazetted Group B Services Combined Examination.
